overall_reason: Nine colour tokens set the dark palette, but white is retyped in rules, and type and spacing are literals with 11 sizes (13, 14, 15 side by side) and three near-identical purple glow recipes.

score.reason: T-SCALE-FIT fails on 11 font sizes with a 13/14/15 chain (TOK-003), T-HARDCODE on six rules that retype --text (TOK-006), and T-DRIFT-PAIRS on three glow shadows (TOK-010).

findings.where: nav, hero trust line, buttons, card titles; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size has 11 sizes for 51 elements: 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, 28, 52, 60, 88. The hero trust line is 13px, nav links 14px, the primary button 15px (near_duplicates 13/14 and 14/15), and the card icon 28px. All 18 font-size declarations are literal. The type_ladder sweep hit counts the same 11.
findings.before: Three small sizes a pixel apart and 11 sizes on a short page
findings.after: Five steps (for example 13, 15, 18, 28, 60) as tokens next to the colour tokens
findings.why: Neighbouring sizes do not read as hierarchy and each new element picks its own.

findings.evidence: declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value.colour lists 6 rules typing #ffffff, which equals a declared colour token; colour declarations are 52% var and 48% literal.
findings.before: White typed in six rules beside the token for it
findings.after: Those rules read the existing text token
findings.why: A palette change would miss the retyped rules.

findings.where: nav CTA, hero CTA, feature icon tiles; 1440 (tiles/1440-01.png)
findings.before: Three glow recipes differing by 0.1 alpha or 8px blur
findings.why: Recipes a hair apart do one job.

strengths: A small colour set: --bg, --bg-elev, --border, --text and --text-muted over four named hues; 3 text colours render at 1440.
not_investigated: T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the readable CSS.
T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: no framework fingerprint beyond single class names.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a landing page); no contract. The page is judged on its own values only.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
